title: Close changes that will not ship
description: Close changes that will not ship
acceptance_criteria: change close moves each named draft, approved, implementing or verifying change into .specsync/archive/closed/<date>-<id>/ byte for byte with close.json (actor, reason, from_state, replaced_by, relay, reviewed false); status, show and ship-status name the close; list, check and new no longer use it; a batch with one bad id closes none; a change whose materialized spec text has not merged is refused naming what to restore or remove

answers.constraints: no new change state; nothing reviewed, accepted or written into a spec; closed-late behaviour unchanged; SpecSync 6.0 to 6.3 never read the closed folder
